subject: Australian Jews stalk and harass Grace Tame over ABC podcast on autism - Who org...
posts:
An advocate speaking on autism is targeted by organized harassment, showing how ideological groups weaponize outrage to silence public discussion.

Grace Tame Harassment ABC
Evidence: free speech, targeted harassment, censorship
#auspol

The group claims to be defending community standards, religious respect, and fighting against offensive media portrayals.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 1.0) — Lesser Good

In reality, they organized a targeted campaign of stalking and harassment against an individual to force compliance.
Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, -2.0) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Using coordinated intimidation to silence an advocate destroys the possibility of open public discourse.
Following an ABC podcast discussing autism, advocate Grace Tame became the target of organized stalking and harassment by specific interest groups seeking to suppress her perspective.

The Bright Side:
Public backlash against the harassment highlights a strong community desire to protect advocates from coordinated bullying.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is framing this as a defense of community values (WHAT) when it is actually an exercise of coercive power (WHO).

It is a bait-and-switch: claiming moral injury to justify inflicting real harm.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between defending community standards and organizing a targeted harassment campaign...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. A terminal zone where intimidation is normalized as a tool of cultural censorship.

The Unavoidable Truth: Coercive harassment is never about dialogue; it is about silencing dissent.

The Unavoidable Lie: That stalking an advocate is a legitimate form of community protest.

Alethekanon:
Coordinated harassment campaigns are structural attacks on the public square. When groups use intimidation to bypass debate, they reveal their inability to engage on logical grounds.

Awwthekanon:
No one should have to face fear and stalking just for sharing their story and advocating for others. We must protect vulnerable voices from being drowned out by anger.

Brothekanon:
Imagine getting so mad at a podcast about autism that you start stalking the guest. That's not defending your community, bro, that's just being a straight-up bully. Leave her alone.
